name: Leatherby's Plain Hamburger Basket on Bakery White Bun
whyItWorks: While famous for colossal ice cream sundaes, Leatherby's griddle makes a simple, fresh ground beef patty served plain on a soft white bakery bun with zero dairy or roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the single hamburger plain (meat and bun only). Skip lettuce, tomato, onions, pickles, and fry sauce. Substitute a side of white toast or applesauce for fries.
